name: p7-evals
goal: P7 evals: harness eval subcommand group (list/run/report) with an offline corpus (>=6 tasks x 2 agent stacks), metric collection (first-pass gate rate, scope violations, reviewer FAIL reasons, wall-clock cost) and a static HTML report from the evidence schema; corpus fixtures + plumbing fully offline-tested with a fake agent
accept: harness eval list shows the corpus matrix
harness eval run --dry with a fake agent produces result rows with all metrics
harness eval report renders static HTML with per-stack raw-vs-harnessed comparison
new tests offline-green; full suite green; ruff+mypy clean; playwright gate green

playwright.cmd: cd web && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npx playwright test e2e/dashboard.spec.ts
